questions.question: Which failure should be retried?
options: The company has no website at all
A reviewer confirmed a category twice
questions.explanation: A timeout is transient. A missing website is permanent, an impossible confidence is a bug, and a double confirmation is an invariant violation.

questions.question: Why do the waits grow between retries?
options: To give a struggling server time to recover instead of hammering it
To make the batch slower on purpose
questions.explanation: Backing off reduces load on the failing dependency and raises the chance the next attempt succeeds.

questions.question: A crashed batch is restarted with the same run ID. What stops duplicate results?
options: The unique index on the idempotency key
questions.explanation: Same run and same company give the same key, so the second insert does nothing.
